summary: Compatibility layer for selected Baldur's Gate 3 mods. Fixes broken item mechanics, aligns effects with their descriptions, and applies targeted runtime patches. Load it after every mod it patches.
descriptionText:
Patch Relay is a compatibility layer for selected Baldur's Gate 3 mods. It uses minimal stat overrides and targeted Script Extender handlers.

• Aligns item mechanics, status durations, conditions and resource formulas with their descriptions.
• Restores item properties and status links that did not work.
• Fixes misleading or missing effect descriptions and displayed values.
• Maintains targeted fixes and item progression additions for DnD 5.5e All-in-One BEYOND, Ancient Mega Pack and Fade's Equipment Distribution AIO.

Load Patch Relay after every mod it patches. Script Extender 29+ is required for runtime handlers.

Full patch list, affected versions and source details: https://github.com/Underslumber/bg3-patch-relay
